data.notes: March 2026 mixed cherry-blossom outdoor festivals, Asian pop/hip-hop at Makuhari, BABYMETAL-led arena/live-house shows, and a particularly strong WOMB club calendar.

events.title: HEAD IN THE CLOUDS Music & Arts Festival in TOKYO
events.summary: 88rising’s Head in the Clouds festival held its Tokyo-area edition at Makuhari Messe with BE:FIRST, Rich Brian, MAX, HANA, KiiiKiii, Ayumu Imazu and no na on March 28, followed by Chanmina, AI, Jay Park x LNGSHOT, Kvi Baba, BIBI and MILLI on March 29.

events.title: Spring Love 春風 2026
events.summary: The long-running free outdoor Spring Love Harukaze festival returned to Yoyogi Park with DJ KRUSH, Killer-Bong, Jun Inagawa, Mari Sakurai, HAPPY, IORI, OCCA, Tomocomo, Tuff Session and many more across multiple stages.

events.title: TOKYO FM 55th Anniversary BABYMETALのメタラジ！FES
events.summary: BABYMETAL’s TOKYO FM anniversary event brought BABYMETAL, Maximum the Hormone and Atarashii Gakko! to Tokyo Garden Theater, with doors at 17:00 and show at 18:00.

events.title: BABYMETAL WORLD TOUR 2026 IN JAPAN
events.summary: BABYMETAL played a Tokyo live-house date at Zepp Haneda with METALVERSE as opening act, scheduled for 19:00 after an 18:00 door time.

events.title: Love International × Rainbow Disco Club
events.summary: Love International staged a one-night WOMB takeover with support from Rainbow Disco Club, headlined by Paranoid London live alongside Dave Harvey, Sisi, Chida and Monkey Timers.

events.title: WOMB Presents Nicole Moudaber
events.summary: Nicole Moudaber returned to WOMB for a techno headline set, joined on the main floor by Risa Taniguchi and Kulage, with additional local lineups across the club’s other floors.

events.title: Reprise: DJ Nobu All Night Long
events.summary: DJ Nobu’s WOMB resident party Reprise featured a rare all-night-long set from DJ Nobu, with VJ Kozee, sound design by Yori, and support from Yamarchy, Akie, Yama and Kabuto.

events.title: KULU 7th Anniversary
events.summary: KULU marked its seventh anniversary at WOMB with triple headliners DESIREE, Nico Stojan and Kotoe, plus Akiram En, You Forgot, Tonbo, Mitokon, Levolant and Satica.

events.title: INTER
events.summary: INTER’s March WOMB edition featured Japanese electronic heavyweights Takkyu Ishino and Shinichi Osawa on the main floor, with Shannon Brothers, Taro Toko, Akira Arasawa, Mark Mila and LOA-floor guests also billed.

events.title: OMNI + DIRECTIONAL
events.summary: Elli Arakawa’s omni + directional hosted ORBE’s first Japan and Asia performance, with Stephanie Sykes, Chida, Chanaz, LØST, YANNY and Yogg across the three-floor WOMB program.

events.title: J: Binh All Night Long
events.summary: DJ Masda’s vinyl-focused party J brought Time Passages founder Binh to WOMB for an all-night-long main-floor set, with Sisi also playing all night on the AKARIYA-presented floor.

events.title: 22 Years Mule Musiq
events.summary: Japanese label Mule Musiq celebrated 22 years at WOMB with a Henrik Schwarz & Kuniyuki live session, label founder Toshiya Kawasaki, and additional sets from Dubby, Sam Fitzgerald, Yoshirotten, KZA, Kyomi and DNG.
